annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1810 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/1668 as regards harmonised standards on application equipment for coating materials, machinery for supply and circulation of liquid coating materials, explosion suppression systems and automatic electrostatic application systems for ignitable liquid coating materials
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1810 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/1668 as regards harmonised standards on application equipment for coating materials, machinery for supply and circulation of liquid coating materials, explosion suppression systems and automatic electrostatic application systems for ignitable liquid coating materials
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (L series)
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision of 11 September 2025 amending Decision (EU) 2022/1668 to publish references of revised harmonised standards (EN 1953, EN 12621, EN 14373 amendment, EN 50176) for coating equipment in explosive atmospheres under the ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU, conferring presumption of conformity. Not AI-related.
key_provisions_or_claims: Annex I to Decision 2022/1668 amended: rows 10, 12, 28, 61 deleted and replaced by 10a, 12a, 28a, 61a.
New standards EN 1953:2025, EN 12621:2025, EN 14373:2021/A1:2025, EN 50176:2025 confer presumption of conformity with ATEX Directive.
Deletion of the superseded standards' references applies from 12 March 2027.
Decision enters into force on the day of publication.
